# Redblue benchmarks

Generated by `cargo run --bin rb-bench`. This checked-in baseline records the verified answer and the wall time measured on the landing machine named below; the untracked `BENCH_TIMINGS.md` holds the record for the latest run.

For the complete, cumulative historical speedup log tracking performance gains across compiler phases (such as Phase 074's +52.4% speedup and future JIT phases), see [`docs/PERFORMANCE_HISTORY.md`](docs/PERFORMANCE_HISTORY.md). Only the answer is asserted by the test gate. The wall time is a debug-build reference: compare it on the same machine with `rb-bench --compare BENCH.md`, or compare the ratio between workloads across machines. Timings vary by machine and by run and are never asserted. The hardware line is best-effort; on a platform that does not expose a CPU model it says so explicitly.

| Workload | Size | Answer | Wall time |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| fibonacci | 20 | 6765 | 0.971 ms |
| primes | 1000 | 168 | 41.473 ms |
| concat | 200 |  | 0.936 ms |
| lex | 200 | 200 | 0.613 ms |

## Hardware

- CPU: Intel(R) Xeon(R) 6973P-C (4 CPUs)
- Build: debug (`cargo run --bin rb-bench`), linux x86_64
